description: 2-layer cascade: validity (MATCH vs NOT_THIS_ROUTE) then completeness (IDA_FULL/IDA_PARTIAL/VOLTA_FULL/VOLTA_PARTIAL, only when MATCH). NOT_THIS_ROUTE collapses the original BOTH/DIFFERENT_ROUTE/INVALID split; scratch.trip_finder_labels itself keeps every label in that original 7-class form -- see _normalize_decision.
